prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres, slightly soft
hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows where one
sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph / stencil print
grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Details are built from small cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
wood planks), not painted lines.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha, no chroma-key colour
behind it, no coloured fringe), every object complete and separated by clear transparent
gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the object, no text, no captions, no logos.
View: front-facing, very slight three-quarter, the same for every object on the sheet.

For request 22-stone-path only, the following asset-specific layout and camera supersede the general view and gutters. Render a square RGBA 2×2 game tile atlas with four equal quadrants precisely divided at half width and height. No separators or padding at the quadrant boundaries. Actual transparent alpha outside stones and at the outer road fringes. Slightly overhead top-down view showing only stone tops. Use the paper atlas input for cut paper fibres, layered shapes and fine printed grain, the red wall input for mottled weathered ink, and the two JPG inputs only for naturally rounded irregular stone shapes and arrangement. Pale warm grey, off-white and subtle sage-grey, finely printed mottling, shallow contact shadows. Top left stoneFill is a full-bleed square of irregular, varied rounded flagstones, tight pale beige or sparse grass gaps, mathematically periodic at all four exact quadrant boundaries. Individual stones cropped on one boundary resume on the exact opposite edge at precisely the same position and color/outline. Keep density uniform across borders. Top right stoneEdgeL is a left road edge, thin out with progressively smaller stones towards transparent left margin, right boundary joins the left of stoneFill, top and bottom self-repeat. Bottom left stoneEdgeR is its horizontal mirror, outer right transparent. Bottom right stoneEnd is a road end, top boundary joins bottom of stoneFill, with smaller sparse stones towards fully transparent bottom. Use the same stone scale across all quadrants, intended for 48 by 40 world projection. No frames, grid lines, typography, or checkerboard.

Edit the supplied square offset stoneFill image, a single top-down terrain tile. Near the horizontal midline and vertical midline the paper flagstones have abrupt straight cuts and there are dark holes. Paint through those cuts and holes with continuous irregular rounded flagstones and narrow soil joints. Reconnect sliced stones as natural single pieces with continuous contours, paper fibres and muted warm beige, sage and grey print grain. Keep the density, illumination and scale. Preserve the square framing, overall composition and especially the artwork close to the perimeter wherever possible. Fill to the exact four borders with terrain, with no exterior margin. The external borders are an existing wrap boundary through stones. No text.
notes: 風格參考 public/art/paper-atlas.png（紙雕層次、紙纖維）和 public/art/tainan/confuciusWall.png（斑駁印墨）。石形與排法參考 art-source/refs/stonepath-1.jpg 和 art-source/refs/stonepath-2.jpg。內建 ImageGen 原生 alpha。初稿平鋪可見接線，將接線移至中央交由 ImageGen 編修，合回邊界後重新做 2×2 平鋪檢查。左右路緣使用鏡像外緣，靠內側使用與填滿磚接合的像素。圖集 1200 × 1200，每格 600 × 600。
